030/**
031 * Sealed marker interface implemented by {@link Property}, the reusable, key-based
032 * description of a configuration property that can be resolved against a
033 * {@link LogProperties} instance. Start with {@link #builder()} (equivalently
034 * {@link Property#builder()}) to describe the key(s) a property should be looked up under
035 * and how its raw String value should be converted, and finish with
036 * {@link Property#get(LogProperties)} or {@link Property#bind(LogProperties)} to resolve
037 * it into a {@link Result}.
038 *
039 * @see Property
040 * @see LogProperties
041 */
042@CaseChanging
043public sealed interface LogProperty {
044
045        /**
046         * Builder
047         * @return property getter builder.
048         */
049        public static RootPropertyGetter builder() {
050                return Property.builder();
051        }
052
053        /**
054         * An error friendly {@link Function} for converting properties.
055         *
056         * @param <T> input type.
057         * @param <R> output type.
058         * @param <E> error type.
059         */
060        public interface PropertyFunction<T extends @Nullable Object, R extends @Nullable Object, E extends Exception>
061                        extends Function<T, R> {
062
063                @Override
064                default R apply(T t) {
065                        try {
066                                return _apply(t);
067                        }
068                        catch (Exception e) {
069                                sneakyThrow(e);
070                                throw new RuntimeException(e);
071                        }
072                }
073
074                /**
075                 * Apply that throws error.
076                 * @param t input
077                 * @return output
078                 * @throws E if an error happened in function.
079                 */
080                public R _apply(T t) throws E;
081
082                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
083                private static <E extends Throwable> void sneakyThrow(final Throwable x) throws E {
084                        throw (E) x;
085                }
086
087        }
088
089        /**
090         * Parent interface for property exceptions.
091         */
092        sealed interface PropertyProblem {
093
094        }
095
096        /**
097         * Property helper mixin.
098         */
099        interface PropertySupport {
100
101                /**
102                 * String key value properties.
103                 * @return properties.
104                 */
105                public LogProperties properties();
106
107                /**
108                 * Gets the value for the property.
109                 * @param <T> property type.
110                 * @param property to use for lookup.
111                 * @return value.
112                 */
113                default <T> T value(Property<T> property) {
114                        return property.get(properties()).value();
115                }
116
117        }
118
119        /**
120         * Thrown if an error happens while converting a property.
121         */
122        final static class PropertyConvertException extends RuntimeException implements PropertyProblem {
123
124                private static final long serialVersionUID = -6260241455268426342L;
125
126                /**
127                 * Key.
128                 */
129                private final String key;
130
131                /**
132                 * Creates convert exception.
133                 * @param key property key.
134                 * @param message error message
135                 * @param cause maybe null.
136                 */
137                PropertyConvertException(String key, String message, @Nullable Throwable cause) {
138                        super(message, cause);
139                        this.key = key;
140                }
141
142                /**
143                 * Property key.
144                 * @return key.
145                 */
146                public String key() {
147                        return this.key;
148                }
149
150        }
151
152        /**
153         * Throw if property is missing.
154         */
155        final static class PropertyMissingException extends NoSuchElementException implements PropertyProblem {
156
157                private static final long serialVersionUID = 4203076848052565692L;
158
159                /**
160                 * Creates a missing property exception.
161                 * @param s error message.
162                 */
163                PropertyMissingException(String s) {
164                        super(s);
165                }
166
167        }
168
169        /**
170         * Thrown by {@link Validator#validate()} when one or more of the accumulated
171         * {@link Result}s failed, reporting every failure in a single message instead of just
172         * the first one encountered.
173         */
174        final static class ValidationException extends RuntimeException implements PropertyProblem {
175
176                private static final long serialVersionUID = -8416817560218813225L;
177
178                ValidationException(String message, @Nullable Throwable cause) {
179                        super(message, cause);
180                }
181
182                /**
183                 * Validates a list of results and throws {@link ValidationException} if any
184                 * results are not {@link Success}.
185                 * @param builder class to prefix to full message.
186                 * @param results list of results.
187                 * @throws ValidationException if any result in the supplied list is not
188                 * successful.
189                 */
190                public static void validate(Class<?> builder, List<Result<?>> results) throws ValidationException {
191                        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder().append("Validation failed for ")
192                                .append(builder.getName())
193                                .append(":");
194                        Throwable cause = null;
195                        boolean failed = false;
196                        for (var r : results) {
197                                switch (r) {
198                                        case Result.Success<?> s -> {
199                                                continue;
200                                        }
201                                        case Result.Missing<?> m -> {
202                                                sb.append("\n");
203                                                sb.append(m.message());
204                                                failed = true;
205                                        }
206                                        case Result.Error<?> e -> {
207                                                sb.append("\n");
208                                                sb.append(e.message());
209                                                if (cause == null) {
210                                                        cause = e.cause();
211                                                }
212                                                failed = true;
213                                        }
214                                }
215                        }
216                        if (failed) {
217                                throw new ValidationException(sb.toString(), cause);
218                        }
219
220                }
221
222        }
223
224        /**
225         * Accumulates {@link Result}s from one or more property lookups and validates them
226         * together, so that a caller resolving several properties in sequence can report
227         * every failure at once instead of failing fast on the first bad property.
228         * <p>
229         * This is the mechanism generated {@code fromProperties(LogProperties)} builder
230         * implementations use: each property is looked up and its {@link Result} is added to
231         * the validator as it is read; {@link #validate()} is then called once at the end,
232         * after all properties have been read, so a user who misconfigured several properties
233         * sees all of the problems together rather than fixing them one at a time across
234         * repeated runs.
235         * <p>
236         * Use {@link #add(Result)} for a property that is required: a {@link Result.Missing}
237         * is treated as a failure. Use {@link #addIfError(Result)} for an optional property
238         * that already has a fallback applied (typically via {@link Result#or(Object)} with
239         * the builder's current field value): a {@link Result.Missing} is expected in that
240         * case and is silently ignored, but a {@link Result.Error} (the property was present
241         * but failed to convert) is still a real problem and is reported.
242         *
243         * @apiNote a {@code Validator} is single-use: create one with {@link #of(Class)}, add
244         * every result that should be checked, and call {@link #validate()} exactly once at
245         * the end.
246         */
247        public static class Validator {
248
249                private final List<Result<?>> results = new ArrayList<>();
250
251                private final Class<?> builder;
252
253                /**
254                 * Creates a validator whose {@link ValidationException} messages will be prefixed
255                 * with the name of the given class.
256                 * @param builder the class on whose behalf properties are being resolved -
257                 * typically the builder calling this method. It is only used to identify the
258                 * source of a failure in the exception message; no state is read from it.
259                 * @return newly created validator.
260                 */
261                public static Validator of(Class<?> builder) {
262                        return new Validator(builder);
263                }
264
265                private Validator(Class<?> builder) {
266                        this.builder = builder;
267                }
268
269                /**
270                 * Adds a result that must be present. Both {@link Result.Missing} and
271                 * {@link Result.Error} will cause {@link #validate()} to fail. Use this for a
272                 * required property; for an optional property that already has a fallback value
273                 * applied, use {@link #addIfError(Result)} instead so a missing value does not
274                 * itself trigger a failure.
275                 * @param result result to check.
276                 * @return this.
277                 */
278                public Validator add(Result<?> result) {
279                        results.add(result);
280                        return this;
281                }
282
283                /**
284                 * Adds a result only if it is a {@link Result.Error}; a {@link Result.Missing}
285                 * result is silently ignored. Intended for an optional property that has already
286                 * had a fallback value applied (for example via {@link Result#or(Object)}): the
287                 * property being absent is expected and fine, but if it was present and failed to
288                 * convert that should not be swallowed.
289                 * @param result result to check.
290                 * @return this.
291                 */
292                public Validator addIfError(Result<?> result) {
293                        if (result instanceof Result.Error<?> e) {
294                                results.add(e);
295                        }
296                        return this;
297                }
298
299                /**
300                 * Validates every result added so far via {@link #add(Result)} or
301                 * {@link #addIfError(Result)}, throwing a single exception listing all failures
302                 * if one or more of them are not {@link Result.Success}.
303                 * @throws ValidationException if any added result is a {@link Result.Missing}
304                 * (added via {@link #add(Result)}) or a {@link Result.Error} (added via either
305                 * method).
306                 */
307                public void validate() throws ValidationException {
308                        ValidationException.validate(builder, results);
309                }
310
311        }
312
313        /**
314         * A supplier of a property result. Can be lazy but does not have to be. A non lazy
315         * PropertyValue is {@link Result}.
316         *
317         * @param <T> property type.
318         * @see Result
319         * @see Property#bind(LogProperties)
320         */
321        interface PropertyValue<T> extends Supplier<Result<T>> {
322
323                /**
324                 * Gets result.
325                 * @return result.
326                 */
327                @Override
328                public Result<T> get();
329
330                /**
331                 * Gets the value and will fail with {@link NoSuchElementException} if there is no
332                 * value.
333                 * @return value.
334                 * @throws PropertyMissingException if there is no value.
335                 * @throws PropertyConvertException if the property failed conversion.
336                 */
337                default T value() throws PropertyMissingException, PropertyConvertException {
338                        return get().value();
339                }
340
341                /**
342                 * Returns the current result if fallback is null or returns fallback as a result
343                 * if this result is missing.
344                 * @param fallback maybe <code>null</code>.
345                 * @return value.
346                 */
347                public PropertyValue<T> or(@Nullable T fallback);
348
349                /**
350                 * Returns the current result if success or error otherwise fallback supplier is
351                 * used. If the supplier returns <code>null</code> then the result will be mising.
352                 * @param fallback may return <code>null</code> but not recommended.
353                 * @return value.
354                 */
355                public PropertyValue<T> or(Supplier<T> fallback);
356
357                /**
358                 * Overrides the result with a value if it is not <code>null</code> regardless if
359                 * the original Result is an error or not. <strong>This overrides even an error
360                 * result from {@link #get()}!</strong> This is equivalent to
361                 * <code>replacement == null ? value.value() : replacement;</code>.
362                 * @param replacement value to use to override.
363                 * @return result with replacement if it is not null.
364                 */
365                default T override(@Nullable T replacement) {
366                        if (replacement != null) {
367                                return replacement;
368                        }
369                        return value();
370                }
371
372                /**
373                 * Map a result
374                 * @param <U> result type
375                 * @param mapper mapping function.
376                 * @return mapped result.
377                 */
378                public <U> PropertyValue<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper);
379
380        }
381
382        /**
383         * The result of a property fetched from properties.
384         *
385         * @param <T> property type.
386         */
387        sealed interface Result<T> extends PropertyValue<T> {
388
389                @Override
390                default Result<T> get() {
391                        return this;
392                }
393
394                /**
395                 * Gets the value.
396                 * @return value or <code>null</code>.
397                 */
398                public @Nullable T valueOrNull();
399
400                /**
401                 * Gets a value if there is if not uses the fallback.
402                 * @param fallback maybe <code>null</code>.
403                 * @return value.
404                 */
405                default @Nullable T valueOrNull(@Nullable T fallback) {
406                        var v = valueOrNull();
407                        if (v != null) {
408                                return v;
409                        }
410                        return fallback;
411                }
412
413                /**
414                 * Gets the value and will fail with {@link NoSuchElementException} if there is no
415                 * value.
416                 * @return value.
417                 * @throws PropertyMissingException if there is no value.
418                 * @throws PropertyConvertException if the property failed conversion.
419                 */
420                @Override
421                public T value() throws PropertyMissingException, PropertyConvertException;
422
423                /**
424                 * Gets a value if there if not uses the fallback if not null otherwise throws an
425                 * exception.
426                 * @param fallback maybe <code>null</code>.
427                 * @return value.
428                 * @throws PropertyMissingException if no property and fallback is
429                 * <code>null</code>.
430                 * @throws PropertyConvertException if the property failed conversion.
431                 */
432                default T value(@Nullable T fallback) throws PropertyMissingException, PropertyConvertException {
433                        if (fallback == null) {
434                                return value();
435                        }
436                        return value(() -> fallback);
437                }
438
439                /**
440                 * Returns the current result if fallback is null or returns fallback as a result
441                 * if this result is missing.
442                 * @param fallback maybe <code>null</code>.
443                 * @return value.
444                 */
445                @Override
446                public Result<T> or(@Nullable T fallback);
447
448                /**
449                 * Returns the current result if success or error otherwise fallback supplier is
450                 * used. If the supplier returns <code>null</code> then the result will be mising.
451                 * @param fallback may return <code>null</code> but not recommended.
452                 * @return value.
453                 */
454                @Override
455                public Result<T> or(Supplier<T> fallback);
456
457                /**
458                 * Map a result
459                 * @param <U> result type
460                 * @param mapper mapping function.
461                 * @return mapped result.
462                 */
463                @Override
464                public <U> Result<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper);
465
466                /**
467                 * Gets a value if there if not uses the fallback if not null otherwise throws an
468                 * exception.
469                 * @param fallback maybe <code>null</code>.
470                 * @return value.
471                 * @throws PropertyMissingException if no property and fallback is
472                 * <code>null</code>.
473                 * @throws PropertyConvertException if the property failed conversion.
474                 */
475                public T value(@SuppressWarnings("exports") Supplier<? extends @Nullable T> fallback)
476                                throws PropertyMissingException, PropertyConvertException;
477
478                /**
479                 * Convenience that turns a value into an optional.
480                 * @return optional.
481                 */
482                default Optional<T> optional() {
483                        return Optional.ofNullable(valueOrNull());
484                }
485
486                /**
487                 * A description of the result for error messages.
488                 * @return description.
489                 */
490                public String describe();
491
492                /**
493                 * A property that is present.
494                 *
495                 * @param <T> property type.
496                 */
497                public sealed interface Success<T> extends RequiredResult<T> {
498
499                        @Override
500                        default @Nullable T valueOrNull() {
501                                return value();
502                        }
503
504                        /**
505                         * Gets the value and will never fail for Success.
506                         * @return value.
507                         */
508                        @Override
509                        public T value();
510
511                        @Override
512                        default T value(@SuppressWarnings("exports") Supplier<? extends @Nullable T> fallback) {
513                                return value();
514                        }
515
516                        @Override
517                        default Success<T> or(@Nullable T fallback) {
518                                return this;
519                        }
520
521                        @Override
522                        default Success<T> or(Supplier<T> fallback) {
523                                return this;
524                        }
525
526                        /**
527                         * Original property key where the value was derived from or was passed a
528                         * fallback.
529                         * @return key.
530                         */
531                        public String key();
532
533                        /**
534                         * A property that was not found in properties but had a fallback value
535                         * supplied.
536                         *
537                         * @param <T> property type.
538                         * @param key original property key.
539                         * @param value actual value.
540                         */
541                        public record ValueSuccess<T>(String key, T value) implements Success<T> {
542                                /**
543                                 * Successfully found property value.
544                                 * @param key key of the original property.
545                                 * @param value actual value should not be <code>null</code>.
546                                 */
547                                public ValueSuccess {
548                                        if (value == null) {
549                                                throw new NullPointerException("value");
550                                        }
551                                }
552
553                                @Override
554                                public <U> Result<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
555                                        try {
556                                                U u = mapper._apply(value);
557                                                return new ValueSuccess<>(key, u);
558                                        }
559                                        catch (Exception e) {
560                                                return Error.of(key, e);
561                                        }
562                                }
563
564                                @Override
565                                public String describe() {
566                                        return "Fallback[" + key + "]=" + value;
567                                }
568
569                        }
570
571                        /**
572                         * A property that is present.
573                         *
574                         * @param <T> property type.
575                         * @param value actual value.
576                         * @param property found property.
577                         */
578                        public record PropertySuccess<T>(FoundProperty property, T value) implements Success<T> {
579                                /**
580                                 * Successfully found property value.
581                                 * @param value actual value should not be <code>null</code>.
582                                 * @param property found property.
583                                 */
584                                public PropertySuccess {
585                                        if (value == null) {
586                                                throw new NullPointerException("value");
587                                        }
588                                }
589
590                                @Override
591                                public String key() {
592                                        return property.key();
593                                }
594
595                                @Override
596                                public <U> Result<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
597                                        try {
598                                                U u = mapper._apply(value);
599                                                return new PropertySuccess<>(property, u);
600                                        }
601                                        catch (Exception e) {
602                                                return Error.of(property.key(), e);
603                                        }
604                                }
605
606                                @Override
607                                public String describe() {
608                                        return "Property[" + property.key() + "]=" + property.valueDescription();
609                                }
610
611                        }
612
613                }
614
615                /**
616                 * A property that is missing (<code>null</code>).
617                 *
618                 * @param <T> property type.
619                 * @param keys keys.
620                 * @param message description of where the property is missing.
621                 */
622                public record Missing<T>(List<String> keys, String message) implements Result<T> {
623                        /**
624                         * A property that is missing (<code>null</code>).
625                         * @param keys keys.
626                         * @param message description of where the property is missing.
627                         */
628                        public Missing {
629                                if (keys.isEmpty()) {
630                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("one key is required");
631                                }
632                        }
633
634                        @Override
635                        public @Nullable T valueOrNull() {
636                                return null;
637                        }
638
639                        @Override
640                        public T value() throws NoSuchElementException {
641                                throw new PropertyMissingException(message);
642                        }
643
644                        @Override
645                        public T value(@SuppressWarnings("exports") Supplier<? extends @Nullable T> fallback)
646                                        throws NoSuchElementException {
647                                T v = fallback.get();
648                                if (v != null) {
649                                        return v;
650                                }
651                                throw new PropertyMissingException(message);
652                        }
653
654                        @Override
655                        public Result<T> or(@Nullable T fallback) {
656                                if (fallback != null) {
657                                        return new Success.ValueSuccess<>(keys.get(0), fallback);
658                                }
659                                return this;
660                        }
661
662                        @Override
663                        public Result<T> or(Supplier<T> fallback) {
664                                return or(fallback.get());
665                        }
666
667                        /**
668                         * Helper just to cast the result to a different parameterized type.
669                         * @param <R> parameterized type.
670                         * @return this.
671                         */
672                        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
673                        public <R> Missing<R> convert() {
674                                return (Missing<R>) this;
675                        }
676
677                        @Override
678                        public <U> Missing<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
679                                return convert();
680                        }
681
682                        @Override
683                        public String describe() {
684                                return "Missing[" + keys + "]";
685                        }
686
687                }
688
689                /**
690                 * A property that was present but failed conversion.
691                 *
692                 * @param <T> property type.
693                 * @param key property key that failed to convert.
694                 * @param message failure message.
695                 * @param cause exception thrown while trying to convert.
696                 */
697                @SuppressWarnings("JavaLangClash")
698                public record Error<T>(String key, String message, Exception cause) implements RequiredResult<T> {
699                        /*
700                         * TODO consider rename to Failure
701                         */
702                        @Override
703                        public @Nullable T valueOrNull() {
704                                throw new PropertyConvertException(key, message, cause);
705                        }
706
707                        @Override
708                        public T value() throws PropertyConvertException {
709                                throw new PropertyConvertException(key, message, cause);
710                        }
711
712                        @Override
713                        public T value(@SuppressWarnings("exports") Supplier<? extends @Nullable T> fallback)
714                                        throws PropertyConvertException {
715                                throw new PropertyConvertException(key, message, cause);
716                        }
717
718                        @Override
719                        public Error<T> or(@Nullable T fallback) {
720                                return this;
721                        }
722
723                        @Override
724                        public Error<T> or(Supplier<T> fallback) {
725                                return this;
726                        }
727
728                        /**
729                         * Helper just to cast the result to a different parameterized type.
730                         * @param <R> parameterized type.
731                         * @return this.
732                         */
733                        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
734                        public <R> Error<R> convert() {
735                                return (Error<R>) this;
736                        }
737
738                        @Override
739                        public <U> Error<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
740                                return convert();
741                        }
742
743                        static <U> Error<U> of(String resolvedKey, Exception cause) {
744                                String message = "Error for property. key: " + resolvedKey + ", " + cause.getMessage();
745                                return new Error<U>(resolvedKey, message, cause);
746                        }
747
748                        @Override
749                        public String describe() {
750                                return "Error[" + key + "](" + message + ")";
751                        }
752                }
753
754        }
755
756        /**
757         * A result that is not missing and will either be an error or success.
758         *
759         * @param <T> property type.
760         */
761        sealed interface RequiredResult<T> extends Result<T> {
762
763        }

765        /**
766         * A property description that can retrieve a property result by being passed
767         * {@link LogProperties}. <em>The property instance does not actually contain the
768         * value of the property!</em>.
769         *
770         * @param <T> property type.
771         * @see Result
772         */
773        sealed interface Property<T> extends LogProperty {
774
775                /**
776                 * Gets the first key.
777                 * @return key.
778                 */
779                public String key();
780
781                /**
782                 * Gets a property value as a result.
783                 * @param properties key values.
784                 * @return result.
785                 */
786                public Result<T> get(LogProperties properties);
787
788                /**
789                 * Maps the property to another value type.
790                 * @param <U> value type.
791                 * @param mapper function to map.
792                 * @return property.
793                 */
794                public <U> Property<U> map(PropertyFunction<? super T, ? extends U, ? super Exception> mapper);
795
796                /*
797                 * TODO do we really need propertyString?
798                 */
799                /**
800                 * Converts the value into a String that can be parsed by the built-in properties
801                 * parsing of types. Supported types: String, Boolean, Integer, URI, Map, List.
802                 * @param value to be converted to string.
803                 * @return property representation of value.

807                /**

811                 * value.

815                /**

820                 * @throws NoSuchElementException if the value is null.

832                /**
833                 * Builder.

841                 * Creates a lazy result from the properties.
842                 * @param properties properties used to retrieve a value when the supplier is
843                 * called.

852        /**
853         * Builds property keys.
854         *
855         * @param <B> this.
856         */
857        sealed abstract class AbstractKeysBuilder<B> {
858
859                private List<PartialKey> keys = new ArrayList<>();
860
861                private Map<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
862
863                AbstractKeysBuilder() {
864                }
865
866                /**
867                 * Adds an additional key to try.
868                 * @param key key to try.
869                 * @return this
870                 */
871                public B addKey(String key) {
872                        keys.add(new PartialKey(key, new LinkedHashMap<>()));
873                        return self();
874                }
875
876                /**
877                 * Adds a key with a <code>{name}</code> parameter.
878                 * @param key key to be interpolated.
879                 * @param name name.
880                 * @return this
881                 */
882                public B addKeyWithName(String key, String name) {
883                        addKey(key);
884                        return addNameParam(name);
885                }
886
887                /**
888                 * Adds a parameter to the last added key
889                 * @param name parameter name.
890                 * @param value value of parameter.
891                 * @return this.
892                 */
893                public B addParam(String name, String value) {
894                        var key = keys.getLast();
895                        key.params.put(name, value);
896                        return self();
897                }
898
899                /**
900                 * Adds a a <code>{name}</code> parameter the last added key.
901                 * @param value value of parameter.
902                 * @return this.
903                 */
904                public B addNameParam(String value) {
905                        return addParam(LogProperties.NAME, value);
906
907                }
908
909                PartialKeys buildKeys() {
910                        return new PartialKeys(keys, params);
911                }
912
913                record PartialKey(String key, Map<String, String> params) {
914                        PartialKey makeImmutable() {
915                                return new PartialKey(key, Map.copyOf(params));
916                        }
917
918                        String interpolate(Function<String, @Nullable String> fallback) {
919                                return LogProperties.interpolateKey(key, fallback(params::get, fallback));
920                        }
921                }
922
923                record PartialKeys(List<PartialKey> keys, Map<String, String> params) {
924
925                        PartialKeys {
926                                keys = keys.stream().map(PartialKey::makeImmutable).toList();
927                                params = Map.copyOf(params);
928                        }
929
930                        List<String> interpolate(Function<String, @Nullable String> paramFunction) {
931                                return keys.stream().map(e -> {
932                                        return e.interpolate(fallback(paramFunction, params::get));
933                                }).distinct().toList();
934                        }
935
936                        List<String> interpolate() {
937                                return keys.stream().map(e -> {
938                                        return e.interpolate(params::get);
939                                }).distinct().toList();
940                        }
941                }
942
943                abstract B self();
944
945        }
946
947        private static Function<String, @Nullable String> fallback(Function<String, @Nullable String> a,
948                        Function<String, @Nullable String> b) {
949                return k -> {
950                        var v = a.apply(k);
951                        if (v != null)
952                                return v;
953                        return b.apply(k);
954                };
955        }
956
957        /**
958         * Builds a {@link Property} (or a {@link LogProvider} via {@link #provider}) that is
959         * looked up under one or more keys tried in order: if the value is not found under
960         * the first key added, the next key added is tried, and so on. Created via
961         * {@link PropertyGetter#withKey(String)}.
962         *
963         * @param <T> value type.
964         */
965        final class PropertyKeyBuilder<T> extends AbstractKeysBuilder<PropertyKeyBuilder<T>> {
966
967                private final PropertyGetter<T> getter;
968
969                private PropertyKeyBuilder(PropertyGetter<T> getter) {
970                        this.getter = getter;
971                }
972
973                /**
974                 * Builds the property with the supplied keys.
975                 * @return property
976                 */
977                public Property<T> build() {
978                        return property(buildKeys().interpolate());
979                }
980
981                private Property<T> property(List<String> keys) {
982                        return getter.build(keys.get(0), keys.subList(1, keys.size()).toArray(new String[] {}));
983                }
984
985                /**
986                 * Creates a provider that will replace <code>{name}</code> property key
987                 * parameters.
988                 * @param <U> provider type.
989                 * @param mapper function to maper property value to provider type.
990                 * @return provider.
991                 */
992                public <U> LogProvider<U> provider(PropertyFunction<T, LogProvider<U>, ? super Exception> mapper) {
993                        return (n, c) -> {
994                                Map<String, String> named = Map.of(LogProperties.NAME, n);
995                                return property(buildKeys().interpolate(named::get)).get(c.properties())
996                                        .map(mapper)
997                                        .value()
998                                        .provide(n, c);
999                        };
1000                }
1001
1002                @Override
1003                protected PropertyKeyBuilder<T> self() {
1004                        return this;
1005                }
1006
1007        }
1008
1009        /**
1010         * Extracts and converts from {@link LogProperties} and is also an immutable builder
1011         * for {@link Property}s.
1012         *
1013         * @param <T> value type.
1014         */
1015        sealed interface PropertyGetter<T> {
1016
1017                /**
1018                 * Gets a result from properties.
1019                 * @param props properties.
1020                 * @param key property key usually dotted.
1021                 * @return result.
1022                 */
1023                Result<T> get(LogProperties props, String key);
1024
1025                /**
1026                 * Gets a result from properties by trying a list of keys.
1027                 * @param props properties.
1028                 * @param keys list of property keys usually dotted.
1029                 * @return result.
1030                 */
1031                default Result<T> get(LogProperties props, List<String> keys) {
1032                        for (String key : keys) {
1033                                var r = get(props, key);
1034                                @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse bug
1035                                @Nullable
1036                                Result<T> found = switch (r) {
1037                                        case Result.Success<T> s -> s;
1038                                        case Result.Error<T> s -> s;
1039                                        case Result.Missing<T> s -> null;
1040                                };
1041                                if (found != null) {
1042                                        return found;
1043                                }
1044                        }
1045                        return findRoot(this).missingResult(props, keys);
1046                }
1047
1048                /**
1049                 * Converts the value into a String that can be parsed by the built-in properties
1050                 * parsing of types. Supported types: String, Boolean, Integer, URI, Map, List.
1051                 * @param value to be converted to string.
1052                 * @return property representation of value.
1053                 */
1054                String propertyString(T value);
1055
1056                /**
1057                 * Determines full name of key.
1058                 * @param key key.
1059                 * @return fully qualified key name.
1060                 */
1061                default String fullyQualifiedKey(String key) {
1062                        return findRoot(this).fullyQualifiedKey(key);
1063                }
1064
1065                /**
1066                 * Validates the key is correctly prefixed.
1067                 * @param key dotted key.
1068                 */
1069                default void validateKey(String key) {
1070                        String fqn = fullyQualifiedKey(key);
1071                        if (!fqn.startsWith(LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX)) {
1072                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1073                                                "Property key should start with: '" + LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "'. key = " + key);
1074                        }
1075                        if (fqn.endsWith(".") || fqn.startsWith(".")) {
1076                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1077                                                "Property key should not start or end with '" + LogProperties.SEP + "'");
1078                        }
1079                        LogProperties.validateKeyParameters(key, Set.of());
1080                }
1081
1082                /**
1083                 * Creates a property builder with the given first key.
1084                 * @param key first key to try.
1085                 * @return builder to add more keys.
1086                 */
1087                default PropertyKeyBuilder<T> withKey(String key) {
1088                        return new PropertyKeyBuilder<>(this).addKey(key);
1089                }
1090
1091                /**
1092                 * Creates a Property from the given key and this getter.
1093                 * @param key key.
1094                 * @return property.
1095                 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the key is malformed.
1096                 */
1097                default Property<T> build(String key) throws IllegalArgumentException {
1098                        validateKey(key);
1099                        return new DefaultProperty<>(this, List.of(key));
1100                }
1101
1102                /**
1103                 * Creates a Property from the given key and this getter.
1104                 * @param key key.
1105                 * @param otherKeys additional keys to try.
1106                 * @return property.
1107                 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the key is malformed.
1108                 */
1109                default Property<T> build(String key, String... otherKeys) throws IllegalArgumentException {
1110                        List<String> keys = combine(key, otherKeys);
1111                        for (var k : keys) {
1112                                validateKey(k);
1113                        }
1114                        return new DefaultProperty<>(this, keys);
1115                }
1116
1117                private static List<String> combine(String key, String... otherKeys) {
1118                        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>();
1119                        keys.add(key);
1120                        for (var o : otherKeys) {
1121                                keys.add(o);
1122                        }
1123                        return keys.stream().distinct().toList();
1124                }
1125
1126                /**
1127                 * Creates a Property from the given key and its {@value LogProperties#NAME}
1128                 * parameter.
1129                 * @param key key.
1130                 * @param name interpolates <code>{name}</code> in property name with this value.
1131                 * @return property.
1132                 */
1133                default Property<T> buildWithName(String key, String name) {
1134                        return withKey(key).addNameParam(name).build();
1135                }
1136
1137                /**
1138                 * Find root property getter.
1139                 * @param e property getter.
1140                 * @return root.
1141                 */
1142                @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse bug
1143                public static RootPropertyGetter findRoot(PropertyGetter<?> e) {
1144                        return switch (e) {
1145                                case RootPropertyGetter r -> r;
1146                                case ChildPropertyGetter<?> c -> findRoot(c.parent());
1147                        };
1148                }
1149
1150                /**
1151                 * Default root property getter.
1152                 * @return property getter.
1153                 */
1154                public static RootPropertyGetter of() {
1155                        return new RootPropertyGetter("");
1156                }

1158                /**
1159                 * A property getter and <strong>builder</strong> that has no conversion but may

1161                 * <p>
1162                 * While you can map the string properties with {@link #map(PropertyFunction)} it
1163                 * is preferred to use the <code>of</code> methods on this class for basic types
1164                 * especially for list or map types as the implementation will call the
1165                 * implementation specific in LogProperties. An example is {@link #ofMap()} which
1166                 * will call the LogProperties implementation of
1167                 * {@link LogProperties#mapOrNull(String)}.

1169                 */

1171
1172                        /**
1173                         * Prefix to be added to key.
1174                         */
1175                        protected final String prefix;
1176
1177                        RootPropertyGetter(String prefix) {
1178                                super();
1179                                this.prefix = prefix;
1180                        }
1181
1182                        private final static class SearchPropertyGetter extends RootPropertyGetter {
1183
1184                                SearchPropertyGetter(String prefix) {
1185                                        super(prefix);
1186                                }
1187
1188                                @Override
1189                                <T extends @Nullable Object> @Nullable T findOrNull(LogProperties props, String key,
1190                                                BiFunction<LogProperties, String, @Nullable T> func) {
1191                                        return props.findOrNull(prefix, key, func);
1192                                }
1193
1194                                /**
1195                                 * Will prefix key.
1196                                 * @param prefix prefix.
1197                                 * @return new property getter.
1198                                 */
1199                                @Override
1200                                public SearchPropertyGetter withPrefix(String prefix) {
1201                                        return new SearchPropertyGetter(prefix);
1202                                }
1203
1204                        }
1205
1206                        <T extends @Nullable Object> @Nullable T findOrNull(LogProperties props, String key,
1207                                        BiFunction<LogProperties, String, @Nullable T> func) {
1208                                return func.apply(props, fullyQualifiedKey(key));
1209                        }
1210
1211                        FoundProperty.@Nullable StringProperty stringOrNull(LogProperties props, String key) {
1212                                return findOrNull(props, key, LogProperties::stringPropertyOrNull);
1213                        }
1214
1215                        FoundProperty.@Nullable ListProperty listOrNull(LogProperties props, String key) {
1216                                return findOrNull(props, key, LogProperties::listPropertyOrNull);
1217                        }
1218
1219                        FoundProperty.@Nullable MapProperty mapOrNull(LogProperties props, String key) {
1220                                return findOrNull(props, key, LogProperties::mapPropertyOrNull);
1221                        }
1222
1223                        static <T, R> Success<R> convert(Success<T> success, R value) {
1224                                return switch (success) {
1225                                        case Success.PropertySuccess<T> ps -> new Success.PropertySuccess<R>(ps.property, value);
1226                                        case Success.ValueSuccess<T> vs -> new Success.ValueSuccess<R>(vs.key(), value);
1227                                };
1228                        }
1229
1230                        @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse null bug
1231                        Result<List<String>> getList(LogProperties props, String key) {
1232                                FoundProperty.@Nullable ListProperty prop = listOrNull(props, key);
1233                                if (prop == null) {
1234                                        return missingResult(props, List.of(key));
1235                                }
1236                                return new Result.Success.PropertySuccess<>(prop, prop.value());
1237                        }
1238
1239                        @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse null bug
1240                        Result<Map<String, String>> getMap(LogProperties props, String key) {
1241                                FoundProperty.@Nullable MapProperty prop = mapOrNull(props, key);
1242                                if (prop == null) {
1243                                        return missingResult(props, List.of(key));
1244                                }
1245                                return new Result.Success.PropertySuccess<>(prop, prop.value());
1246                        }
1247
1248                        @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse null bug
1249                        @Override
1250                        public Result<String> get(LogProperties props, String key) {
1251                                var v = stringOrNull(props, key);
1252                                if (v == null) {
1253                                        return missingResult(props, List.of(key));
1254                                }
1255                                return new Result.Success.PropertySuccess<>(v, v.value());
1256                        }
1257
1258                        @Override
1259                        public String propertyString(String value) {
1260                                return value;
1261                        }
1262
1263                        <T> Result.Error<T> errorResult(LogProperties props, String fqk, Exception e) {
1264                                String resolvedKey = props.description(fqk);
1265                                return Result.Error.of(resolvedKey, e);
1266                        }
1267
1268                        <T> Result.Error<T> errorResult(LogProperties props, String key, Exception e, Success<?> previousResult) {
1269                                @SuppressWarnings("null")
1270                                FoundProperty fp = switch (previousResult) {
1271                                        case Success.ValueSuccess<?> vs -> null;
1272                                        case Success.PropertySuccess<?> ps -> ps.property();
1273                                };
1274                                String fqk = fullyQualifiedKey(key);
1275                                if (fp == null) {
1276                                        return errorResult(props, fqk, e);
1277                                }
1278                                var badProps = fp.properties();
1279                                String resolvedKey = "'" + fqk + "' from " + badProps.description(fqk);
1280                                String message;
1281                                if (e instanceof PropertyConvertException || e instanceof ValidationException) {
1282                                        message = "Error converting property. key: " + resolvedKey + ", value: '" + fp.valueDescription()
1283                                                        + "' cause:\n" + e.getMessage();
1284                                }
1285                                else {
1286                                        message = "Error for property. key: " + resolvedKey + ", " + e.getClass().getName() + " "
1287                                                        + e.getMessage();
1288                                }
1289
1290                                message += "\nTried: '" + fqk + "' from " + props.description(fqk);
1291
1292                                return new Result.Error<>(resolvedKey, message, e);
1293                        }
1294
1295                        <T> Result.Missing<T> missingResult(LogProperties props, List<String> keys) {
1296                                List<String> resolvedKeys = describeKeys(props, keys);
1297                                String message = "Property missing. keys: " + resolvedKeys;
1298                                return new Result.Missing<>(keys, message);
1299                        }

1301                        List<String> describeKeys(LogProperties props, List<String> keys) {
1302                                return keys.stream().<String>map(k -> {
1303                                        String fqk = fullyQualifiedKey(k);
1304                                        return "'" + fqk + "' from " + props.description(fullyQualifiedKey(k));
1305                                }).toList();
1306                        }

1308                        /**
1309                         * Will search with prefix.
1310                         * @param prefix prefix.
1311                         * @return new property getter.
1312                         */
1313                        public RootPropertyGetter withSearch(String prefix) {
1314                                return new SearchPropertyGetter(prefix);
1315                        }
1316
1317                        /**
1318                         * Will prefix key.
1319                         * @param prefix prefix.
1320                         * @return new property getter.
1321                         */
1322                        public RootPropertyGetter withPrefix(String prefix) {
1323                                return new RootPropertyGetter(prefix);
1324                        }
1325
1326                        @Override
1327                        public String fullyQualifiedKey(String key) {
1328                                return LogProperties.concatKey(prefix, key);
1329                        }

1396                /**
1397                 * A {@link PropertyGetter} that delegates to a {@link #parent()} getter and
1398                 * transforms its result, rather than reading directly from {@link LogProperties}

1400                 * {@link PropertyGetter#mapResult(PropertyFunction)},
1401                 * {@link PropertyGetter#orElse(Object)}, and
1402                 * {@link PropertyGetter#orElseGet(Supplier)} are all child getters chained onto
1403                 * some ancestor {@link RootPropertyGetter}.

1409                        /**
1410                         * The getter this one delegates to before applying its own conversion.
1411                         * @return parent getter.
1412                         */
1413                        PropertyGetter<?> parent();
1414
1415                        @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse bug
1416                        @Override
1417                        default String propertyString(T value) {
1418                                return switch (value) {
1419                                        case null -> throw new NullPointerException("null value passed into propertyString");
1420                                        case String s -> s;
1421                                        case Boolean b -> String.valueOf(b);
1422                                        case Integer i -> String.valueOf(i);
1423                                        case URI u -> String.valueOf(u);
1424                                        case Map<?, ?> m -> MapGetter._propertyString(m);
1425                                        case List<?> list -> ListGetter._propertyString(list);

1432                /**

1437                 * {@link #mapResult(PropertyFunction)} for mappers that only need the value
1438                 * itself and not the surrounding {@link Result.Success}.

1445                                .apply(r.value());

1453                 * {@link #map(PropertyFunction)} is implemented in terms of this method.
1454                 * @param <U> value type.
1455                 * @param mapper function.
1456                 * @return new property getter.
1457                 */
1458                default <U> PropertyGetter<U> mapResult(
1459                                PropertyFunction<Result.Success<T>, ? extends U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
1460                        return new ResultFuncGetter<T, U>(this, mapper, null);

1463                /**

1465                 * @param fallback fallback value.
1466                 * @return new property getter.
1467                 */
1468                default PropertyGetter<T> orElse(T fallback) {
1469                        if (fallback == null) {
1470                                throw new NullPointerException();
1471                        }
1472                        return new FallbackGetter<T>(this, () -> fallback);
1473                }
1474
1475                /**
1476                 * Fallback to value if property not found.
1477                 * @param fallback supplier.
1478                 * @return new property getter.
1479                 */
1480                default PropertyGetter<T> orElseGet(Supplier<? extends T> fallback) {
1481                        Objects.requireNonNull(fallback, "fallback");
1482                        return new FallbackGetter<T>(this, fallback);
1483                }
1484
1485        }
1486
1487}
1488
1489record DefaultProperty<T>(PropertyGetter<T> propertyGetter, List<String> keys) implements LogProperty.Property<T> {
1490
1491        public DefaultProperty {
1492                Objects.requireNonNull(propertyGetter);
1493                if (keys.isEmpty()) {
1494                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("should have at least one key");
1495                }
1496        }
1497
1498        /**
1499         * Gets the first key.
1500         * @return key.
1501         */
1502        @Override
1503        public String key() {
1504                return keys.get(0);
1505        }
1506
1507        @Override
1508        public Result<T> get(LogProperties properties) {
1509                return propertyGetter.get(properties, keys);
1510        }
1511
1512        @Override
1513        public <U> LogProperty.Property<U> map(PropertyFunction<? super T, ? extends U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
1514                return new DefaultProperty<>(propertyGetter.map(mapper), keys);
1515        }
1516
1517        @Override
1518        public String propertyString(T value) {
1519                return propertyGetter.propertyString(value);
1520        }
1521
1522        @Override
1523        public void set(T value, BiConsumer<String, T> consumer) {
1524                if (value != null) {
1525                        consumer.accept(key(), value);
1526                }
1527        }
1528
1529}

1531final class DefaultPropertyValue<T> implements LogProperty.PropertyValue<T> {
1532
1533        final Supplier<Result<T>> delegate;
1534
1535        DefaultPropertyValue(Supplier<Result<T>> delegate) {
1536                this.delegate = delegate;
1537        }
1538
1539        @SuppressWarnings({ "nullness", "null" })
1540        @Override
1541        public Result<T> get() {
1542                return delegate.get();
1543        }
1544
1545        @Override
1546        public String toString() {
1547                return "PropertyValue.memoize(" + delegate + ")";
1548        }
1549
1550        @Override
1551        public PropertyValue<T> or(@Nullable T fallback) {
1552                return new DefaultPropertyValue<>(() -> Objects.requireNonNull(delegate.get()).or(fallback));
1553        }
1554
1555        @Override
1556        public PropertyValue<T> or(Supplier<T> fallback) {
1557                return new DefaultPropertyValue<>(() -> Objects.requireNonNull(delegate.get()).or(fallback));
1558        }
1559
1560        @Override
1561        public <U> PropertyValue<U> map(PropertyFunction<T, U, ? super Exception> mapper) {
1562                return new DefaultPropertyValue<>(() -> Objects.requireNonNull(delegate.get()).map(mapper));
1563        }
1564
1565}

1567record FallbackGetter<T>(PropertyGetter<T> parent, Supplier<? extends T> fallback) implements ChildPropertyGetter<T> {
1568
1569        @Override
1570        public String propertyString(T value) {
1571                return parent.propertyString(value);
1572        }
1573
1574        @Override
1575        public Result<T> get(LogProperties props, String key) {
1576                return get(props, List.of(key));
1577        }
1578
1579        @SuppressWarnings("null")
1580        @Override
1581        public Result<T> get(LogProperties props, List<String> keys) {
1582
1583                Result<T> r = parent.get(props, keys);
1584                return switch (r) {
1585                        case Result.Success<T> s -> s;
1586                        case Result.Error<T> s -> s;
1587                        case Result.Missing<T> s -> {
1588                                if (keys.isEmpty()) {
1589                                        yield s;
1590                                }
1591                                String key = keys.getFirst();
1592                                T f = fallback.get();
1593                                if (f == null) {
1594                                        yield PropertyGetter.findRoot(parent) //
1595                                                .errorResult(props, keys.get(0),
1596                                                                new LogProperty.PropertyMissingException("fallback returned null"));
1597                                }
1598                                yield new Result.Success.ValueSuccess<>(key, f);
1599                        }
1600                };
1601
1602        }
1603
1604}
1605
1606record MapGetter(RootPropertyGetter parent) implements ChildPropertyGetter<Map<String, String>> {
1607
1608        @Override
1609        public Result<Map<String, String>> get(LogProperties props, String key) {
1610                return parent.getMap(props, key);
1611        }
1612
1613        @Override
1614        public String propertyString(Map<String, String> value) {
1615                return _propertyString(value);
1616        }
1617
1618        static String _propertyString(Map<?, ?> value) {
1619                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
1620                boolean first = true;
1621                for (var e : value.entrySet()) {
1622                        if (first) {
1623                                first = false;
1624                        }
1625                        else {
1626                                sb.append("&");
1627                        }
1628                        PercentCodec.encode(sb, String.valueOf(e.getKey()), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
1629                        Object v = e.getValue();
1630                        if (v != null) {
1631                                sb.append("=");
1632                                PercentCodec.encode(sb, String.valueOf(v), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
1633                        }
1634                }
1635                return sb.toString();
1636        }
1637
1638}
1639
1640record ListGetter(RootPropertyGetter parent) implements ChildPropertyGetter<List<String>> {
1641
1642        @Override
1643        public Result<List<String>> get(LogProperties props, String key) {
1644                return parent.getList(props, key);
1645        }
1646
1647        @Override
1648        public String propertyString(List<String> list) {
1649                return _propertyString(list);
1650        }
1651
1652        static String _propertyString(List<?> list) {
1653                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
1654                boolean first = true;
1655                for (var e : list) {
1656                        if (first) {
1657                                first = false;
1658                        }
1659                        else {
1660                                sb.append(",");
1661                        }
1662                        PercentCodec.encode(sb, String.valueOf(e), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
1663                }
1664                return sb.toString();
1665        }
1666
1667}
1668
1669record ResultFuncGetter<T, R>(PropertyGetter<T> parent,
1670                PropertyFunction<Result.Success<T>, ? extends R, ? super Exception> mapper,
1671                @Nullable PropertyFunction<? super R, ? extends String, ? super Exception> stringFunc)
1672                implements
1673                        ChildPropertyGetter<R> {
1674
1675        @Override
1676        @SuppressWarnings("nullness") // TODO checker seems to have issues with pattern
1677                                                                        // matching.
1678        public Result<R> get(LogProperties props, String key) {
1679                var result = parent.get(props, key);
1680                Result<R> rvalue = switch (result) {
1681                        case Result.Success<T> s -> {
1682                                try {
1683                                        R r = mapper._apply(s);
1684                                        if (r == null) {
1685                                                yield PropertyGetter.findRoot(parent).missingResult(props, List.of(key));
1686                                        }
1687                                        else {
1688                                                yield RootPropertyGetter.convert(s, Objects.requireNonNull(r));
1689                                        }
1690                                }
1691                                catch (Exception e) {
1692                                        yield PropertyGetter.findRoot(parent).errorResult(props, key, e, s);
1693                                }
1694                        }
1695                        case Result.Error<T> e -> e.convert();
1696                        case Result.Missing<T> m -> m.convert();
1697                        case null -> throw new NullPointerException("bug");
1698                };
1699                return rvalue;
1700        }
1701
1702        @Override
1703        public String propertyString(R value) {
1704                var f = stringFunc;
1705                if (f != null) {
1706                        return f.apply(value);
1707                }
1708                return ChildPropertyGetter.super.propertyString(value);
1709        }
1710
1711}
